title: Barrier (General Defensive Jutsu)
body:
Syntax: perform barrier

A room-bound chakra guard learned by everyone at level 35. Reduces incoming damage by 25% for 180 seconds before duration scaling. Any room change removes the effect immediately, including teleportation and staff transfers. Costs 30 Chakra before level scaling and has a 12-second cooldown.

Advanced room-bound defenses:
  Reinforced Barrier (level 70): 35% reduction, 240 seconds, 65 Chakra.
  Fortress Barrier (level 150): 45% reduction, 300 seconds, 120 Chakra.

Use PERFORM REINFORCED BARRIER or PERFORM FORTRESS BARRIER. They replace weaker room-bound barriers; reductions never stack.

Player-bound toggles (work while moving):
  Sanctuary (level 90): 50% less damage, 5 Chakra upkeep per 5 seconds.
  Elemental Shield (level 100): 30% less damage, +5 accuracy, +15% own-nature jutsu damage; 6 Chakra upkeep per 5 seconds.

The strongest active reduction always wins; you never become invulnerable by combining shields. Normal practice requirements apply.
